description: This Java class implements the default configuration for DevOps-related settings within the Eclipse Ditto gateway utility module, including properties such as secure status and passwords, loaded via configuration with fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: DefaultDevOpsConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the DevOpsConfig interface, providing configuration data such as secure status and passwords for DevOps, loaded from a Config object.

methods.name: DefaultDevOpsConfig.of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultDevOpsConfig instance from a given Config object, using a fallback mechanism and configuration path.

methods.name: isSecureStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the secure status is enabled.
